mode.title: Mode
mode.description: search = query/filters; lookup = list of SIREN/SIRET numbers.

query.title: Search text
query.description: Company name, acronym, SIREN or address words (search mode).

sirenNumbers.title: SIREN / SIRET numbers
sirenNumbers.description: Lookup mode: 9-digit SIREN or 14-digit SIRET (head office or any establishment). Max 1,000.

nafCodes.title: NAF/APE activity codes
nafCodes.description: Main activity codes (NAF rév. 2 format, e.g. 62.01Z, 70.22Z).

section.title: NAF section
section.description: Activity section letter A-U (e.g. J = information & communication).

postCodes.title: Postcodes
postCodes.description: Companies with an establishment in these postcodes (e.g. 75008).

legalForms.title: Legal forms (nature juridique)
legalForms.description: Insee legal-form codes, e.g. 5710 SAS, 5499 SARL, 5599 SA, 9220 association. Codes 1xxx (entreprises individuelles) are always excluded.

excludeMarketingOptOut.title: Exclude companies opposed to marketing use (recommended)
excludeMarketingOptOut.description: ON (default): drop companies that objected in the RNE to reuse of their data for commercial prospecting (API field opposition_diffusion_commerciale; GDPR art. 21(2), Code de commerce R.123-320). If you turn it OFF, records with marketingOptOut=true may only be used for non-marketing purposes such as KYB, compliance and credit checks, never for prospecting; you are the data controller.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum companies to return (search mode). The API caps a query at 10,000.
